verses.text: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the LORD his God.
He said: "In my trouble I called to the LORD, and he answered me. From deep in the grave I called for help, and you listened to my cry.
You threw me into the deep waters, into the heart of the seas. The currents swirled around me. All your waves and breakers swept over me.
I said, 'I have been sent away from your sight. Yet I will look again toward your holy temple.'
The waters closed in over me and threatened my life. The deep surrounded me. Seaweed was wrapped around my head.
I sank down to the roots of the mountains. The gates of the earth locked me in forever. But you, LORD my God, brought my life up from the pit.
"When my life was slipping away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer rose to you, to your holy temple.
Those who cling to worthless idols turn away from the faithful love that could be theirs.
But I will offer sacrifices to you with songs of thanks. I will keep the promises I made. Salvation comes from the LORD."
Then the LORD gave the fish an order, and it spit Jonah out onto dry land.
